<div class="card-body">
'''Lone Warrior''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊戦士の単独行</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦士が位置カード上で単独で防衛している場合、戦闘運命数を１回引くことができる。戦士が「タッグ」ならば、戦闘運命数を２回引くことができる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の戦士たちは、通常は分隊単位で行動しているが、全員が近接戦闘の訓練を受けており、追い詰められれば果敢な戦いぶりを示す。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' A warrior's solitary action.

'''Card text:''' If a warrior is defending alone at a location card, you may draw battle destiny once. If the warrior is Tagge, you may draw battle destiny twice.

'''Lore:''' Imperial warriors usually operate in squads, but all are trained in close combat and fight resolutely when cornered.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a location card and drawing battle destiny; the English specifies a site and adding battle destiny.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lone Warrior]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=285s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:45.</ref>
